# Sylvester Eqs

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Solve A X + X B = C for two diagonal matrices A and B. Each result equals one divided by the sum of its row and column eigenvalues.

## What this example demonstrates

Solve A X + X B = C for two diagonal matrices A and B. Each result equals one divided by the sum of its row and column eigenvalues.
